original_ai_output.title_zh: 肯尼亚鲁艾土地纠纷引发警民冲突 警方执行驱逐令
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 肯尼亚内罗毕鲁艾地区因土地纠纷爆发警民冲突，警方试图执行驱逐令，将一名声称在该地块居住34年的寡妇迁出。当地居民聚集现场进行抵抗。该寡妇表示已在该争议土地上生活超过三十年，并对驱逐行动提出质疑。

key_facts.fact: 肯尼亚鲁艾地区警方与居民因土地纠纷发生冲突
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ruai Land Dispute Turns Chaotic as Police, Residents Clash Over Eviction

key_facts.fact: 警方试图执行驱逐令，引发居民抵抗
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The confrontation occurred as police attempted to enforce an eviction order involving the parcel, triggering resistance from residents who gathered at the scene.

key_facts.fact: 一名寡妇声称在该争议土地上居住超过34年
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The widow, Wanjiru, said she has lived on the disputed land for more than three decades and questioned the move to remove her from the property.

uncertainties: 事件目前仅有一个来源报道，尚未获得交叉验证
